Her body is low and languid but her eyes are busy — riding the small pendulum arcs of the swaying pendant, blink rate slow, one blink and brief glaze: she is halfway into a memory.
[0.8s–3.8s] She draws the pendant slowly closer, watching the tassel swing and settle; the dust motes swirl through the moonbeam.
